title: Install a runner
lead: A runner executes builds and checks. Pick where to put it.
name: Runner name
nameHint: Optional. A short suffix is added so you can install several runners.
capabilitiesFailed: Could not find out what can be installed on this machine.
busy: An install of this kind is already running. Wait for it to finish.

docker.title: Docker next to the Studio
docker.lead: The Studio starts a runner container through its docker.sock. The runner survives restarts and connects by itself.

kubernetes.title: Deployment in the cluster
kubernetes.lead: The Studio creates a runner Deployment in its namespace under a separate ServiceAccount allowed to touch build pods only.

docker.no_socket: The Studio cannot see docker.sock. In the default install it has no Docker access on purpose: the socket is root on the host. Use the SSH install or the command next to the token.
docker.docker_unreachable: docker.sock exists, but Docker does not answer or the Studio has no right to the socket.
docker.no_permission: The Studio has no rights to Docker.

kubernetes.disabled: Turned off in the chart (runner.installFromUi.enabled). Shared runners are off on production on purpose, so there is no button by default.
kubernetes.not_in_cluster: The Studio does not run inside a Kubernetes cluster.
kubernetes.no_permission: The Studio ServiceAccount may not create a Deployment, Secret and volume in its namespace.

command.title: On another machine
command.lead: Get a token and a ready docker run command or a service script and run it there.

succeeded: The runner is installed and connected to the Studio.

error.unexpected: The install failed for an unexpected reason. See the Studio log for details.
error.image_pull_failed: Could not pull the runner image. Check that Docker can reach the registry.
error.container_start_failed: Docker could not start the container.
error.kube_forbidden: The cluster refused the request. Check the Studio ServiceAccount Role.
error.kube_failed: The cluster returned an error while creating resources.
error.register_timeout: The runner started but did not connect to the Studio within three minutes. Check that it can reach the Studio address and retry.
